# The Great Divergence — Narrative Script

*Audio: 06_The_Great_Divergence.mp3 — July 22, 2026*

---

Year Zero. The reactor at the heart of the Formingar Ocean malfunctioned. What had been an ordinary sea became a wound in the world.

The water turned red. Gold washed ashore in impossible quantities. The Groom — an eternal vortex — opened at the crash site and has never closed. The elven kingdom of Elvengar was destroyed in the cataclysm.

The survivors called it the Great Divergence. It split history into Before and After. Everything that came before — the crash, the forgetting, the first tribes, the first empires — became BGD. Everything after became AGD.

The reactor still functions. The Groom still spins. Whatever sleeps at the bottom of the Formingar Ocean has not finished waking up.
